an6.82:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an6.82:1.3: musāvādī hoti, pisuṇavāco hoti, pharusāvāco hoti, samphappalāpī hoti, luddho ca pagabbho ca.
an6.82:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye’ti.
an6.82:2.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge,
an6.82:2.3: musāvādā paṭivirato hoti pisuṇāvācā paṭivirato hoti, pharusāvācā paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, aluddho ca appagabbho ca.
an6.82:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge’ti.
